messages:
maya: Heads-up — after the Lyra9b PTQ rollout (canary -> prod) we're seeing a sudden uptick in short-response repetition and a faint increase in hallucination rate on our QA evals. Not massive but consistent across multiple prompt families.

devin: Can you paste a couple of failing examples? Also which quant profile did we use (8bit PTQ / per-channel)?

maya: Quick example: `Q: When was the Eiffel Tower built? A: 1889. 1889. 1889.` — repetition at 2-6 tokens after the correct answer on many factual prompts. Using `ptq-8pc` (per-channel 8-bit) with fused-attn enabled.

jules: Hmm. Any correlation with KV cache behavior or batch sizes? Could be KV cache indexing mismatch after quantization.

maya: We tested single-request and small batches (1-4). Repro locally with `--batch=1` still shows the repeat. KV cache logs look normal but I'll attach the snippet.

maya: ```
[2024-07-12 15:02:11] INFO kv_cache: put key shape=(1, 1024, 64)
[2024-07-12 15:02:11] INFO kv_cache: get key hits=1 misses=0
[2024-07-12 15:02:11] WARN generation: repeated_token_penalty applied=0.0
```

akshay: That `repeated_token_penalty applied=0.0` stands out. Our default should set a small penalty for short answers. Did the quant profile strip a bias or change the tokenizer mapping?

devin: Also check softmax temperature flow after quantization. Sometimes PTQ moves logits scale and our postprocessing assumes a different range. Can you dump raw logits for the first 10 steps?

maya: Dumping now. Small sample attached: `logits[step0:5] = [3.2, 0.1, -1.5, 2.9, 3.1]` then later we see two tokens with identical top scores repeated.

jules: If logits have ties more often post-quant, sampling will pick same token repeatedly. Two quick triage items: 1) run eval with `top_k=50` + `top_p=0.95` and 2) try same model in float16 mode (no quant) to confirm regression is PTQ-related.

akshay: I'm starting a small canary rollback to the float16 variant on the affected pool now (ops-bot will post). If float16 looks clean we'll pin a hotfix.

ops-bot: Rollback initiated by akshay on pool `lyra9b-canary-1`. Target: float16 variant. ETA ~5m.

maya: After rolling back, sampled 30 prompts — repetition rate dropped from ~12% -> ~1.5%. So seems PTQ introduced the sampling instability.

devin: Good isolate. Next steps: 1) bisect PTQ calibration (per-channel vs per-tensor), 2) run calibration with MSE vs KL divergence, 3) check for tokenizer ID shifts (off-by-one) in quant pipeline. I'll open a small PR with a debug flag to preserve raw logits and post-quant scaling factors.

jules: Also add a quick eval job that compares perplexity and repetition score across calibration variants. Put the failing prompts in a dedicated suite (label `lyra9b/postlaunch-rep`).

maya: I'll add the suite and upload 200 failing seeds. Thx all — will update thread with bisect results. :thumbsup:

akshay: Thanks. If bisect points to calibration, we can ship a new quant profile and do a canary-only rollout first. If it's tokenizer-related, we may need a faster rollback across pools.

maya: noted. leaving notes on the ticket (#INC-4821) and tagging eng-oncall for visibility.

devin: One last note — log an eval checkpoint comparing token-distribution entropy pre/post quant so we can set a regression alert threshold.

maya: Added. Closing loop for now, will post follow-ups.
